name: youtube
description: Read YouTube through the official Data API for research and channel work. Activates for: (1) pulling comments off a video with replies fully resolved, (2) sweeping comments across a channel including competitors, (3) channel and video metadata, (4) transcripts, (5) exporting comments shaped for an Ultimate Message Map, routed per client. Ships both the `youtube` CLI and MCP tools over one core.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API Key
youtube_api_key.description: API key from a Google Cloud project with YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Public reads only; no OAuth needed. Optional if you set it in ~/.config/youtube-plugin/config.toml instead.
